FOLDER.NAME: SALES_DM
FOLDER.DESCRIPTION: Sales data mart loads - owner: EDW Sales & Merch team

TARGET.DESCRIPTION: Daily sales by date / channel group / product category. Grain: SALES_DATE + CHANNEL_GROUP + PRODUCT_CATEGORY. Schema ANALYTICS.LEGACY
TARGET.NAME: DAILY_SALES_SUMMARY

MAPPING.DESCRIPTION: Loads ANALYTICS.LEGACY.DAILY_SALES_SUMMARY from RAW.SHOP. One row per order date / channel group / product category. All money converted to USD at the monthly FX rate of the ORDER month (USD orders have no FX row -> rate 1). Change log: 2021-03-02 jpark - initial version (CR-1874). 2022-07-19 mlopez - channel grouping via DECODE; APP folded into ONLINE (CR-2010). 2023-01-11 mlopez - exclude QA/test customer accounts via LKP_CUSTOMERS (INC-4471). 2023-11-06 rsingh - CR-2231: exclude zero-qty lines (warehouse adjustment lines were inflating line counts). 2024-05-28 rsingh - lines for deleted products now land in category UNKNOWN with zero cost instead of being dropped (CR-2318).
MAPPING.NAME: m_LOAD_DAILY_SALES_SUMMARY

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Cleans keys used by lookups and derives the reporting channel group.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_NORMALIZE

TRANSFORMFIELD.DESCRIPTION: CR-2010: APP orders reported with WEB as ONLINE. Anything unrecognised (phone, blank) -> OTHER
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: o_CHANNEL_GROUP

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Returns the test-account flag for the order's customer.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_CUSTOMERS

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Category and standard unit cost (USD). No match (deleted product) returns NULLs - handled in EXP_CALC_LINE (CR-2318).
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_PRODUCTS

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Monthly FX rate for the order month. USD has no rows in FX_RATES -> returns NULL -> treated as 1.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: LKP_FX_RATES

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Line-level gross / discount / net in order currency, converted to USD, plus COGS.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_CALC_LINE

TRANSFORMFIELD.DESCRIPTION: Net is rounded from the unrounded order-currency net, not GROSS_USD - DISCOUNT_USD
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: LINE_NET_USD

TRANSFORMFIELD.DESCRIPTION: UNIT_COST is already USD - no FX applied
TRANSFORMFIELD.NAME: LINE_COGS_USD

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Drops QA/test customer lines (INC-4471) and zero-quantity adjustment lines (CR-2231).
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: FIL_EXCLUDE_TEST_AND_ZERO_QTY

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Rolls lines up to SALES_DATE / CHANNEL_GROUP / PRODUCT_CATEGORY.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: AGG_DAILY_SALES

TRANSFORMATION.DESCRIPTION: Margin metrics computed on the aggregated amounts, plus load audit timestamp.
TRANSFORMATION.NAME: EXP_MARGIN

ATTRIBUTE.NAME: Write Backward Compatible Session Log File

WORKFLOW.DESCRIPTION: Nightly sales DM load. Runs after wf_RAW_SHOP_INGEST completes.
WORKFLOW.NAME: wf_DAILY_SALES_SUMMARY

ATTRIBUTE.NAME: Write Backward Compatible Workflow Log File
Save workflow log for these runs
